lists.description: Blacksky: Users who participate in hateful campaigns against Black users or otherwise engage in Anti-Blackness.
Skywatch Blue: Label for posts and accounts which spam users with off-topic replies, engage in troll like behavior, or which engage in concern trolling.

Skywatch Blue: Applied to accounts who self describe as being a 'Trans-Exclusionary Radical Feminist' (TERF), 'Gender Critical' (GC), or 'Gender Realist', as well as high-profile individuals whose body of work identifies them as such, or accounts with multiple posts which attack trans people / use pejorative terms
Skywatch Blue: Username, description, and / or handle which includes MAGA, MAHA, TRUMP, or TRUMP 2024, or posts with #MAGA and #TRUMP2024 hashtags or clear indicators of support for Trump.
Skywatch Blue: Username, handle, and / or description which includes reference to Elon Musk.
Skywatch Blue: Username, handle, and / or description which includes Nazi and neo-nazi symbols, including swastikas, references to the 14 words and Hitler's initials, or double lightning bolts.
Skywatch Blue: Account advocates for or supports racially, ethnically, or ideologically motivated extremism.

@caseyho.com: Accounts that engage in spammy activity. May be partially automated, bots, sock puppets, or compromised. Clusters of accounts on this list behave in near-identical ways to one another. Accounts added according to broadly applied objective criteria and not on an individual basis. (182508 total)
@aimod.social: Users who have posted content generated with AI. Users are added automatically if they use AI-related hashtags.

Skywatch Blue: Applied to posts using hashtags or linking to sites utilized for follow-farming, as well as accounts that frequently make posts of this nature, or those which contain follow-farming oriented hashtags in their bios.
Skywatch Blue: Users who frequently posts links to sources which are used to launder fringe or extremist ideas into mainstream discourse.
